name: DomainSnip Bot
tagline: Weekday-morning digest of your domain keyword alerts, flagging notable .com listings.
description: Every weekday morning it reads the keyword alerts you have saved while hunting for domains and pulls out the .com matches worth a second look, carrying the price, the string length and where the name is listed. Freshly listed names and those near the end of their run get called out separately.
author: uxaistudio
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
